description: This Java source file defines the utility class 'NotesTestingUtil' used for testing android components related to notes, including LiveData handling and mocking SSO accounts within the Notes Android client.

classes.name: NotesTestingUtil
classes.description: A utility class for testing notes features, providing methods for LiveData value retrieval and simulating SSO account management.

methods.name: getOrAwaitValue
methods.description: A generic method that observes a LiveData object, waits for it to emit a value or times out after 2 seconds, then returns the value.

methods.name: mockSingleSignOn
methods.description: Mocks a SingleSignOnAccount by saving its serialized form into SharedPreferences to simulate account management during tests.
